resources.string: Landscape live wallpaper with downloadable galleries, slideshows, Day & Night, and optional widgets.

Deckscape uses one location fix to calculate local sunrise and sunset times. Location access stops after the fix, and only an approximate location is stored on this device. Background location is never requested. Older or non-Google head units may require Android\'s precise permission so GPS can work; Deckscape discards the precise result immediately.

Deckscape uses one location fix for local weather and sunrise and sunset times. Location access stops after the fix, and only an approximate location is stored on this device. Background location is never requested.

Deckscape needs an approximate location to show local weather. It stores the location rounded to 0.1 degrees and can check it once a day when you open the app. Background location is never requested.
While the wallpaper is visible, the approximate location is sent to api.open-meteo.com over HTTPS at most once per hour. Open-Meteo also receives ordinary network information such as your IP address and may retain server logs for up to 90 days. Weather data is provided by Open-Meteo under CC BY 4.0.

Deckscape uses one location fix to set the area for local weather. Location access stops after the fix, and only a location rounded to 0.1 degrees is stored on this device. The approximate location is sent to Open-Meteo only after Weather is enabled. Background location is never requested. Older or non-Google head units may require Android\'s precise permission so GPS can work; Deckscape discards the precise result immediately.
